ISRO successfully places EOS-05 satellite in final orbit

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully placed its Earth Observation Satellite (EOS-05) into its final orbit. The satellite is now positioned 35,884 kilometers above the Earth. The EOS-05 is ISRO's latest satellite, with specific new features highlighted in the coverage.
